environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. A WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB containing two rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching request query strings against the pattern `(?i)(union\s+select|;\s*drop|'\s*or\s+'|extractvalue|load_file)` with action BLOCK at priority 1, and (2) a byte-match condition on query string parameters checking for the literal sequence `'--` (single-quote followed by double-dash) with positional constraint CONTAINS, text transformation URL_DECODE then HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, action BLOCK at priority 2. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules actively evaluate. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint, and the SQLite DB_PATH points to an ephemeral tmpfs mount that is re-initialized on each task start with only seed data (no sensitive data beyond test accounts).
